dispositions.reason: The source says the armless monster remains dangerous with its body alone, so “bare-handed” is physically contradictory.
The source explicitly describes the monster stepping backward, and the replacement restores that direction.
The replacement uses the established rendering of 낭중지추 and preserves the sense that concealed ability eventually reveals itself.
잠룡 is the established “Hidden Dragon” title, not “Sleeping Dragon.”
벽곡단 is replaced with the established term “fasting pills,” making the romanization footnote obsolete; both the term and unused note are removed.
귀신이네 reacts to Choi’s uncanny timing rather than literally identifying him as a ghost.
The replacement restores the established System attribute term “Muscles and Bones” for 근골.
The replacement restores Team Leader Choi’s established contact display name.
Jinho has just been handed the phone and is the person holding it in the source.
Hyuk Mujin addresses Taekyung with the established title “Captain.”
The dream dialogue again refers to Taekyung by the established title “Captain.”

patches.new: Food in Murim was spicy, salty, and bland. And even then, more days than not, I couldn’t eat properly. For thirty days, my stomach had been abused with beef jerky, fasting pills, and rice balls.

summary: Corrects body-action wording, retreat direction, established terminology and titles, an idiomatic timing remark, phone ownership, and forms of address across Chapters 45–48; removes the obsolete fasting-pill footnote.
